label: Some founded accompanying relation with a giving term iff concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed result, attribution deferred: for every history, giving relation and reception predicate, there is an origin relation (a value of the primitive of definition 7b28be97) that is founded on received esse, accompanies received esse at every moment of presence, and whose term gives its bearer being at each moment it is borne, iff weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 holds. Forward by concurrentOfTermGiving; backward by taking the relation of a received-esse thing present at t to whatever gives it being at t. So with the relation left open, accompaniment and giving by the term say exactly what 40a97664 says.
